sources.name: cell03_cam01_2026-08.mp4
sources.format: H.264 MP4, 1080p30, one angle covering the cell

data_provenance.site_timezone: UTC-05:00 (site local; all stamps stored UTC)
data_provenance.clock_sync_method: site NTP; controller clock drift measured at <= 50 ms against the log host

frozen_conditions.comparison_design: matched-window retrospective cohort (baseline window vs post-change window; same task, schedule, and crew)
frozen_conditions.exclusion_rule: first 48 h after the change excluded from the post window (learning transient); maintenance-stop hours excluded from both windows
frozen_conditions.measurement_pipeline: robocore offline replay reconstruction + intervention classifier v0.1.0

labels.label: WRIST_SINGULARITY_ESCAPE
labels.definition: manual recovery after a wrist singularity abort mid-pick

labels.label: GRASP_MISALIGNED_ON_APPROACH
labels.definition: grasp retry loop triggered by approach misalignment

labels.label: MISLOAD_ON_PALLETIZE
labels.definition: manual repositioning of a part on the outfeed pallet

failure_taxonomy.taxonomy_source: customer incident codes mapped onto the runtime failure taxonomy by the analyst; the mapping table is hashed in section 10

evaluation_methodology.design: matched-window retrospective cohort; primary comparison of intervention rate per operating hour between windows
evaluation_methodology.sample_description: 27 matched failure events across the four taxonomy labels were individually comparable between windows; 9 were eliminated in the post window
evaluation_methodology.gate_reference: robocore.stats.PromotionGate parameters recorded for reference; a retrospective fixed-sample evaluation does not run SPRT
evaluation_methodology.acceptance_rule: an improvement claim is published only if the projected rate reduction lies inside the Wilson 95% CI on the observed improvement

statistical_uncertainty.notes: the point value is the analyst projection; the observed fraction is 9/27 = 33.3%; the interval is asymmetric per Wilson

safety_oversight.safety_approval_ref: SAF-2026-0114 (customer safety engineer informed; analysis-only engagement)
safety_oversight.human_oversight_description: the assessment is retrospective; there was no live access to the cell at any time, and all physical operation remained under customer safety jurisdiction throughout
stop_conditions: analysis-only engagement: no runtime stop conditions exist on customer hardware
safety_oversight.analysis_only_attestation: no code was deployed to the customer cell; the runtime executed offline on the exported data package only

verified_improvement.statement: Intervention rate fell from 6.0 to 3.9 per operating hour across the matched window, with the reduction consistent across all four failure taxonomy labels.
